what_to_detect: A permanent with two or more instances of an enters-with-counters keyword (bloodthirst) enters with the sum of every applying instance's counters.
near_miss: A permanent with one instance of the keyword enters with that instance's counters only.
record_fields: effect-half counter_change event (counter_type, delta); Forge merges every instance's enter-with counters into one placement, so the instances show only in the delta
gen-3 card lines kind keyword on the entering permanent
